insights.title: High Frequency of Refresh Control Calls
insights.description: The endpoint POST /sfdemosite130/nml510_refresh_control.xml was called 49 times in a single test, indicating potential inefficiencies.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the necessity of multiple calls to this endpoint and consider implementing caching or optimization strategies.

executiveSummary:
• The testing captured 215 API calls across various workflows, with no failures reported.
• User authentication processes were consistently followed across multiple tests.
• The NML510 refresh control endpoint showed a high call frequency, suggesting potential inefficiencies.
• All workflows successfully executed, indicating stable application performance during tests.
• The observed patterns may indicate areas for optimization, particularly in repeated API calls.
• Understanding the UI and API relationship can enhance user experience and system efficiency.
• Further investigation into the refresh control calls is recommended to improve performance.
